name: Batched Marching Cubes
definition: Extracts a mesh from the SDF field using Marching Cubes. It processes the volume in batches along the X-axis to manage memory, filters boundary artifacts, and optionally colors vertices by normal.
summary: Batched Marching Cubes extracts triangular meshes from Signed Distance Fields by processing volume data in memory-constrained chunks along the X-axis, using a 27-neighbor consistency filter to eliminate boundary artifacts.
